method: Four sequential fresh processes in before/after/after/before order. Before is c58eb3ea; after changes primitive chunk serialization only. Loader-selected library paths verified; neither build contains diagnostic counters. Same deterministic million-row dataset and five warm repetitions per worker per process. No concurrent builds/tests.

report.timing: execute only, includes task pool, materialization and native serialization; excludes Python row iteration, warm plan cache, no PROFILE

filter_project.query: MATCH (n:parallel_item) WHERE n.id % 3 = 0 RETURN n.id, n.id * 7 + n.grp

hash_join.query: MATCH (a:parallel_item), (b:parallel_item) WHERE a.grp = b.grp AND b.id < 17 RETURN a.id, b.id

aggregate_repeated.query: MATCH (n:parallel_item) RETURN n.grp, count(*), sum(n.id), min(n.id), max(n.id), avg(n.id)

aggregate_hot.query: MATCH (n:parallel_item) RETURN n.grp % 1, count(*), sum(n.id), avg(n.id)
